# on_user_subscription_updated()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.on_user_subscription_updated`

## Signature

```python
def on_user_subscription_updated(filters = None, group: int = None) -> Callable: ...
```

## Documentation

Decorator for handling changes of the subscriptions of users to the bot.

This does the same thing as [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md) using the
[`UserSubscriptionUpdatedHandler`](../handlers/UserSubscriptionUpdatedHandler.md).

### Parameters

- **`filters`** (`filters`, *optional*)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your function.

- **`group`** (`int`, *optional*)
  The group identifier, defaults to 0.
